translations.translation: R@khimle sh@fkat'le Allah iseme bel@n bashlyim eshemne.
Chyn maktau gal@mn@rne, boten m@khluklarny t@rbiial@uche Allahu t@gal@g@ tieshle.
Allahu t@gal@ bu don'iada barcha keshel@rg@ m@rkh@m@tle, iag'ni moeminn@rg@ d@, koferl@rg@ d@ nig'm@tl@ren bir@, @mma akhir@tt@ moemin b@nd@l@ren@ gen@ bir@ch@k.
Allahu t@gal@, gadellek bel@n khokem ituche, akhir@t konenen' patshasydyr.
Ii t@rbiiachebez Allah! Bez sin'a gyna gyibad@t kylabyz h@m h@r eshebezd@ sinn@n gen@ iard@m soryibyz.
Ii t@rbiiachebez Allah! Bezl@rne tury iulga kunder! (Tury iul - Kor'@n h@m sonn@t iulydyr).

Ul iulny Sin @uv@lgel@rg@ ingam itep birden', bezl@rne Sinen' achuyn' toshk@n v@ adashkan keshel@rne bideg'@t' h@m zal@l@t iulynnan bashka iulga kunder, iag'ni Sine achulandyrmagan h@m khak iuldan adashmagan keshel@r iulyna kunder!
@lif l@m mim - m@g'n@sen Allah uze gen@ bel@der.
Kor'@nnen' Allahudan in'derelg@n khak kitap ik@nlegend@ hich shik iuk, bu kitap anyn' bel@n gam@l kyluchy t@k'v@ moeminn@rg@ khak iulny kurs@tuche - hid@iatder.
Ul t@k'v@ moeminn@r kurmich@ kurg@n kebi Allahuga yshanalar. H@m iokl@telg@n namazlarny vakytynda ukyilar, h@m Bez birg@n bailyktan sadakalar bir@l@r.

Ii Mukh@mm@d g-m, ul t@k'v@ moeminn@r sin'a in'derelg@n Kor'@ng@ yshanyp, anyn' bel@n gam@l kylalar h@m sinn@n elek in'derelg@n kitaplarga da yshanalar (l@kin T@urat v@ Inzh'il bel@n gam@l kylmyilar) h@m akhir@tk@ d@ yshanyp, anyn' ochen gam@l kylalar.
Ul t@k'va moeminn@r Rabbylary tarafynnan tury iulga kunuchel@r h@m alar akhir@tt@ ostenlek tabuchylar.
Allahuga, Kor'@ng@ yshanmagan koferl@rne Allah g'@zaby bel@n kurkytsan' da, kurkytmasan' da bertigez, hich iman kiterm@sl@r.
Allahu t@gal@ koferl@rnen' kun'ell@ren@ an'lamaulyk, kolaklaryna ishetm@ulek, kuzl@ren@ kurm@ulek p@rd@sen kordy h@m alarga akhir@tt@ olug' g'@zab bulyr.
Moselmannar arasynda monafik'lar da bar, alar Allahuga h@m akhir@t konen@ yshandyk dil@r, l@kin uzl@re yshanuchy tugell@r.
Ul monafik'lar Allahuny h@m moselmannarny aldamakchy bulalar, l@kin hich aldyi almaslar, f@kat' uzl@ren aldyilar, shuny sizmil@r.
Alarnyn' kun'ell@rend@ Allahuga karshylyk chire bar, Allah alarnyn' karshylyk chirl@ren arttyrdy, v@ alarga akhir@tt@ r@nzh'etkuche g'@zabdyr, ialgan soil@g@nn@re ochen.
Zh'ir ostend@ fetn@ chygaryp, keshel@r arasyn bozmagyz diels@ alarga, iuk bez bozmyibyz, b@lki toz@t@bez, dil@r.
An' bulygyz! Shul monafik'lar keshel@r arasyn bozyp, zh'ir ostend@ f@s@d kyluchylar, l@kin shuny uzl@re sizmil@r.

@g@r alarga: "Saf gakylly keshel@r yshangan kebek sez d@ saf kun'el bel@n yshanygyz", - diels@, alar: "Bez akhmaklar yshangan kebek yshanyikmy", - dil@r, an' bulygyz! @lb@tt@, alar uzl@re akhmaklar, l@kin belmil@r.

Ul monafik'lar moselmannarga ochrasalar: "Bez iman kiterdek, seznen' bel@n berg@bez", - dil@r, @g@r uzl@renen' shaitan duslary bel@n kalsalar: "Bez, @lb@tt@, seznen' bel@n berg@bez h@m seznen' bel@n berlekt@ moselmannarny m@skh@r@ kyluchybyz", - dil@r.
Allah alarny uzl@ren katy m@skh@r@ kylyr h@m alarny adashu iulynda kaldyryr, khak iulny taba almyicha, kh@iran bulyp iorerl@r.
Shul monafik'lar tury iulny tashlap, adashu iulyn aldylar. Alarga bozyk s@ud@l@re un'ysh h@m faida birm@de, h@m alar tury iulga kuneluche d@ bulmadylar.
Alarnyn' misaly - karan'gy kicht@ ut iandyryp, uz tir@l@ren iaktyrtkan vakytlarynda Allah utlaryn sunderep, karan'gyda kaldyrgan, hichn@rs@ kurm@uche keshel@r kebider.
Alar khak suzne ishetud@n san'gyraular, khak suzne soil@ud@n telsezl@r, tury iulny kurud@n sukyrlar, alar hid@iatk@ kaitmaslar.

Iaki alar kat-kat karan'gylangan tonne kuk kukr@ule, iashenle katy ian'gyr astynda kalgan keshel@r kebi. Kuk kukr@unen' v@ iashennen' katylygynda barmaklaryn kolaklaryna tygalar, ulemn@n kurkyp. Allah imansyzlarnyn' beten eshl@ren cholgap aluchy.

Iashen uty kuz nurlaryn suyryp alyrga iakynlashty. Iashen uty alarnyn' allaryn iaktyrtsa, bernich@ adym atlyilar, iashen uty kitep, karan'gyda kalsalar, bara almyicha tuktyilar. @g@r Allah tel@s@ ide, @lb@tt@, ishetul@ren h@m kurul@ren alyp alarny kolaksyz, kuzsez kylyr ide. @lb@tt@, Allah h@rn@rs@g@ kadir.
Ii keshel@r! Sezne h@m sezd@n elek bulgan keshel@rne khalyk kyluchy Allahuga gyibad@t kylygyz! Allah gazabynnan kurkuchy zh'oml@senn@n bulu ochen.

Sezne khalyk kyluchy - Allah sezg@ zh'irne tush@k kyldy, ostegezg@ kukne bina kyldy, kukt@n ian'gyr in'derep, sezg@ rizyk bulsyn ochen torle zh'imeshl@r, igenn@r usterde. Allahuga hichkemne, hichn@rs@ne tin'd@sh, okhshash kylmagyz! Uzegez d@ bel@sez Anyn' tin'd@she iuklygyn!

@g@r kolybyzga (Mukh@mm@d g-mg@) in'derg@n Kor'@nn@n shikl@ns@gez, Kor'@n suzl@ren@ okhshashly ber sur@ kiteregez h@m Allahudan bashka barcha iard@mchel@regezne iard@mg@ chakyrygyz! @g@r Kor'@n - Allah suze tugel dig@negez dores bulsa!

@g@r ber sur@ kiter@ almagan bulsagyz, h@m kiter@ d@ almassyz! Kurkygyz zh'@h@nn@m utynnan, anyn' echend@ utyn buluchy - ad@mn@r h@m tashlardyr!! Ul zh'@h@nn@m Kor'@n bel@n gam@l kylmauchy koferl@rg@ kh@zerl@nde.

Inde iman kigerep izge gam@ll@r kyluchylarga, @lb@tt@, aslarynnan elgalar aguchy zh'@nn@tl@r bel@n soenech bir! Zh'@nn@tt@ alarnyn' allaryna zh'imeshl@r kiterelg@nd@ "Bu zh'imeshl@r bez don'iada ashagan zh'imeshl@r", - diiarl@r. L@kin alarnyn' t@me bashka bulyr. Alarga anda hichkemnen' nikakhynda bulmagan pak' khatynnar bulyr, alar zh'@nn@tl@rd@ m@n'ge kalyrlar.

Allahu t@gal@ chebenne v@ chebenn@n ostenr@k urm@kuchne misal itud@, @lb@tt@, oialmas. Kor'@ng@ yshanuchylar bu misalny, @lb@tt@, Rabbylarynnan dip bel@l@r. @mma koferl@r shundyi kh@sh@r@tl@rne misal itep kiterud@ Allahunyn' maksady n@rs@ dil@r. Allah, shundyi misallar bel@n kup keshel@rne adashtyryr, h@m kup keshel@rne tury iulga kunderer. L@kin khak iuldan f@syiklarny gyna adashtyryr.

Ul fasyiklar Allahuga birg@n g'@khedl@ren bozalar h@m kis@rl@r Allahu t@gal@ totashyrga @mer itk@n n@rs@l@rne. Iag'ni moselman bulgan iakyn kard@shl@rd@n h@m Kor'@n bel@n gam@l kyluchy moselmannardan kisel@l@r h@m zh'ir ostend@ torle bozyklyk kylalar, alar h@lak buluchylar.

Ii keshel@r! Allahuga yshanmaska nichek buldyra alasyz? Bit sez don'iaga kilg@nche m@et idegez, Ul sezne tergezde h@m Ul sezne uterer, v@ Ul sezne kyiam@t konne tergezer, annary An'a khokemg@ kaityrsyz.
Ul - Allah zh'ird@ge barcha n@rs@ne seznen' ochen khalyk kyldy, son'ra kukne tozerg@ tel@de h@m kukne zh'ide kat itep tergezde. Ul h@rn@rs@ne beluche.

H@m @itte sinen' Rabbyn' f@resht@l@rg@: "Min, @lb@tt@, zh'ir ostend@ kh@lf@ itep Ad@mne kylmakchymyn. F@resht@l@r @ittel@r: "Ii, Rabbybyz! Bozyklyk kyluchy, sugyshyp kan tuguche zatny zh'ir osten@ kh@lif@ kylasyn'my? Bez is@ Sine maktap t@sbikhl@r @it@bez, h@m Sine h@r kimchelekt@n pak'sen' dip ig'tikad it@bez". Allah f@resht@l@rg@: "Doreslekt@ Min sez belm@g@nne bel@men" - dide.
Allah Ad@mg@ isemn@rnen' barchasyn oir@tte d@, f@resht@l@rg@ @itte: "@g@r dores soil@uchel@rd@n bulsagyz, Ad@m belg@n isemn@rne barchasyn @itep biregez".
F@resht@l@r @ittel@r: "Ii h@r kimchelekt@n pak' bulgan Rabbybyz! Bezd@ hich belem iuk, m@g@r Sin belderg@nne gen@ bel@bez, Sin, @lb@tt@, h@rn@rs@ne beluche, khikm@t bel@n esh kyluchysyn'".

Allah Ad@mg@ @itte: "F@resht@l@rg@ isemn@rnen' barchasyn @itep bir", - dip. Ad@m isemn@rnen' barchasyn @itep birg@ch, Allah f@resht@l@rg@ @itte: "Min sezg@ @itm@demmeni zh'ird@ge v@ kukl@rd@ge iasheren n@rs@l@rne bel@men h@m seznen' achyk eshl@g@n v@ iasheren eshl@g@n eshl@regezne d@ bel@men dip?".
"Khorm@t iozenn@n Ad@mg@ s@zh'd@ kylygyz", - dip f@resht@l@rg@ @itk@n vakytybyzda, alar s@zh'd@ kyldylar, m@g@r Iblis s@zh'd@ kylmady, t@k@bberl@nde h@m koferl@rd@n buldy.
V@ Ad@mg@ @ittek: "Uzen' h@m khatynyn' zh'@nn@tt@ torygyz h@m zh'imeshl@ren kin'lek il@, tel@g@nch@ ashagyz, m@g@r men@ bu agachka iakyn barmagyz, @g@r shuny eshl@s@gez, zalimn@rd@n bulyrsyz".

Iblis, bu agach zh'imeshen ashasagyz zh'@nn@tt@ m@n'ge kalasyz, dip, alarny aldady, alar Iblis suzen@ iiarep, zh'imeshne ashap aldandylar. Iblis alarny zh'@nn@tt@n chygaryp andagy nig'm@tl@rd@n aerdy. Monnan son' @ittek: "Ii Ad@m h@m Iblis, ber-beregezg@ doshman bulganygyz kh@ld@ zh'irg@ in'egez! Sezg@ zh'ird@ toryrlyk uryn h@m iash@u ochen kir@k n@rs@l@r bar, @zh'@legez zh'itk@nche iash@gez".

Ad@m gal@ihis-s@lam t@ub@g@ ashykty h@m Rabbysy tarafynnan oir@tk@n t@ub@-istig'f@r suzl@ren@ iulykty, h@m t@ub@ itep, Allahudan gafu sorady, Allah t@ub@sen kabul itep gonahyn gafu itte. Allah t@ub@l@rne kabul ituche, r@khimle.
Bez @ittek: "Barchagyz da zh'@nn@tt@n chygyp zh'irg@ in'egez!" @mma minem sezg@ tury iulga kunderuche suzl@r, @lb@tt@, kiler, Minem suzl@rem@ iiarg@n zatka kurku h@m kaigy bulmas.
Imansyzlar h@m aiat'l@rebezne ialgan diiuchel@r - ut @hell@reder, alar anda m@n'ge kalyrlar.

Ii Iag'kub balalary! Sezg@ birg@n nig'm@tl@remne kh@terl@gez, h@m T@urat bel@n gam@l kylyrga sezd@n g'@hed aldym, shul gahedemne ut@gez! @g@r Minem g'@hedemne ut@s@gez, Mind@ seznen' gahedegezne ut@rmen h@m zh'@nn@tk@ kertermen, Min'a gyna kol bulygyz h@m Minn@n gen@ kurkygyz!

Kulygyzdagy T@uratka yshanganygyz kh@ld@ Bez in'derg@n Kor'@ng@ d@ yshanygyz, iag'ni anyn' bel@n gam@l kylygyz, Kor'@ng@ berenche koferl@rd@n bulmagyz h@m Beznen' aiat'l@rebezne don'ia malyna satmagyz! Iag'ni bailar malyna kyzygyp, iaki alardan kurkyp, Allah khokemn@ren iasherm@gez h@m uzg@rtm@gez, Minem gazabymnan saklanygyz!
Khakny batyl bel@n butamagyz h@m doreslekne iasherm@gez! Bit uzegez d@ khaklykny bel@sez.
Namazlarny ut@gez h@m z@k@t sadakasyn biregez h@m namaz ukuchylar bel@n berg@ namaz ukygyz, iag'ni Kor'@n iulyn'da bulgan moselmannardan aerylmagyz!
Sez keshel@rne izgelekk@ ondisezme? @mma uzegezne onytasyz, bit sez Allah kitabyn ukyisyz, shuny uilap karamyisyzmy? (Bu aiat' v@gaz' soil@p t@ soil@g@ne bel@n gam@l kylmauchylar khakyndadyr).

Avyrlykny kut@rerg@ chydamly bulyp, v@ namaz ukyp Allahudan iard@m soragyz! Namazlarny vakytynda ut@p baru, @lb@tt@, avyr iokter, m@g@r avyr bulmas, Allahudan kurykkan h@m r@khm@ten omet itk@n t@k'va keshel@rg@.
Chonki alar Rabbylaryna iulygachaklaryn h@m An'a khokemg@ kaitachaklaryn bel@l@r.
Ii Iag'kub balalary! Min sezg@ birg@n nig'm@tl@rne kh@terl@gez h@m nig'm@t birud@ sezne boten don'ia keshel@renn@n artyk kyldym, shuny fikerl@gez!
H@m kurkygyz kyiam@t konenn@n, iard@m it@ almas ul kond@ hichber zat ikenche zatka ber esh bel@n d@! Ul kond@ sh@f@gat' itu kabul itelm@s h@m g'@zabtan kotylu ochen hichn@rs@ alynmas.

Firgaun kavemenn@n sezne kotkaruybyzny da kh@terl@gez! Alar sezne iaman g'@zab bel@n g'@zablap, kyz balalarygyzny kaldyryp, ir balalarygyzny bugazlyi idel@r. Bu eshl@r sezg@ Rabbygyzdan b@la v@ zur kaza ide.
Ian@ fiker itegez, iardyk bez sezl@rg@ d@r'iany h@m sezne kotkaryp, Firgaun kavemen h@lak ittek suda batyryp, uzegez d@ karap tordygyz.

Ian@ kh@terl@gez shuny, Musaga T@uratny in'derm@k ochen Tur tavynda any kyryk kon totmak bel@n v@g'd@ kyldyk. Musa Tur tavyna kitk@ch, sez bozau iasap, shul bozauga gyibad@t kyla bashladygyz. Shunyn' ochen sez zalimn@rsez.
Shul eshegezd@n son' sezne gafu kyldyk, shoker ituegez ochen. Chonki alar Musa kaitkach t@ub@ ittel@r.
Ian@ shuny kh@terl@gez, tury iulga kunelm@klegegez ochen Musa g-mg@ kitap birdek. Ul kitap khak bel@n batyl arasyn aeruchy ide.

Musa g-m kavemen@ @itte: "Ii kavemem! Sez, @lb@tt@, uzegezg@ zolym kyldygyz bozauga tabynganygyz ochen, khalkygyzga t@ub@ itegez, uzegezne uteregez! Iag'ni bozauga tabynuchylarny uteregez, shul sezg@ t@ub@ bulyr. Khalkygyz karshynda bu esh sezg@ kh@erle. Allah t@ub@l@rne kabul it@r, @lb@tt@, Ul - t@ub@l@rne kabul ituche, r@khimle.

"Ian@, ii Musa! Bezg@ Allahuny achyk itep kurs@tmich@, sin'a yshanmyibyz, Allahuny bezg@ kurs@t!" - dig@negezne d@ kh@terl@gez! Allahuny kurerg@ tel@g@n vakytygyzda Anyn' nury sezne totty, ul nurga karap torgan kh@legezd@. (Musa Tur tavyna Allahudan T@urat alyrga barganda uze bel@n berg@ zh'itmesh keshe aldy, ul keshel@rne tau it@gend@ kaldyryp, uze tau osten@ chykty, anda Musa Allah bel@n soil@shte h@m Allah Musaga T@uratny birde. Musa T@uratny alyp, @lege zh'itmesh keshe ianyna kilg@ch, ul keshel@r: "Ii Musa, sin Allahuny kurg@nsen', bezg@ d@ kurs@t", - didel@r. Musa @itte: "Min kurerg@ tel@g@n idem Allahuny, Ul tauga karady h@m tau iaryldy. Min kuryktym h@m t@ub@ ittem", - dide. Alar haman: "Allahuny kurmich@ yshanmyibyz", - didel@r. Shunnan son' Allahu t@gal@ nuryn in'derep, shul zh'itmesh keshene koiderep uterde).
Allah @itte: "Nurym bel@n ianyp ulg@negezd@n son' tergezdek sezne shoker ituegez ochen".

Ii Iag'kub balalary! Bolytny Bez sezg@ kul@g@ kyldyk, h@m sezg@ kukt@n shirb@t h@m kosh iten in'derdek, ashagyz Bez birg@n kh@l@l h@m pak' rizyklarny! Bez alarga zolym kylmadyk, l@kin alar uzl@ren@ zolym kyldylar. (D@r'iadan kotylgach, alarga Allahudan @mer buldy: "Zalim k@ferl@r bel@n sugysh kylygyz", - dip, l@kin alar Allahunyn' @meren ut@m@del@r. G'@zab ochen Allah alarny kyryk el sakhr@d@ kaldyrdy, sh@h@rl@rg@ h@m avyllarga ker@ almadylar, koiash alarny r@nzh'eter buldy, @mma Musa sh@r@f@ten@ ber ak bolyt osl@ren@ kul@g@ buldy.)

Ian@: "@rikh@ sh@h@ren@ keregez", - dip @itk@nemne d@ kh@terl@gez! Iag'ni kyryk eldan son' Musa ulg@ch, Iag'kub balalaryna @rikh@ sh@h@ren@ kererg@ Allahudan @mer buldy. Sh@h@rg@ kerg@ch, andagy rizyklarny kin'lek bel@n tel@g@nch@ ashagyz, sh@h@r kapkasynnan kerg@nd@ bash iep, tub@nchelek bel@n keregez, h@m khatalarybyzny gafu it, Rabbym, dip @itegez! Shulai kylsagyz, khata eshl@regezne iarlykarbyz. Iakhshy eshl@rne kyluchy moeminn@rg@ nig'm@tl@rebezne bik tiz arttyryrbyz.

Iag'kub balalary arasynda bulgan zalimn@r sh@h@rg@ kerg@nd@ uzl@ren@ zolym kyldylar, iag'ni sh@h@r kapkasynnan kerg@nd@ Allahudan @mer itelg@n suzne @itmich@, bashka suzg@ alyshtyrdylar, iag'ni sh@h@rg@ kerg@nd@ Allahudan gafu sorap, t@ub@ itep kerer urnyna, shaitan oir@tk@n suzne @itep, t@k@bberl@nep kerdel@r. Ul zalimn@rg@ iavyzlyk kylgannary ochen kukt@n risvai ituche g'@zab in'derdek.

Ian@ shuny kh@terl@gez, Musa uzenen' kaveme ochen Allahudan su sorady, Bez Musaga @ittek: "Taiagyn' bel@n tashka suk", - dip. Musa taiagy bel@n tashka sukty, tashtan chishm@ akty, chonki alar kabil@ idel@r. H@r kabil@ uzenen' chishm@sen belde. Allah birg@n rizyklardan ashagyz, echegez, @mma zh'ir ostend@ bozyklyk kylyp iorm@gez, dip @itelde alarga Allahudan.

Ian@ @ittegez: "Ii Musa, bez ber torle gen@ rizykka sabyr it@ almyibyz, beznen' ochen Rabbyn'nan doga kyl, zh'ird@ us@ torgan n@rs@l@rd@n: kyiar, sarymsak, sugan h@m vak orlyklardan sorap". Musa alarga @itte: "Allah birg@n @uv@lge iakhshy rizyklarny uzegez soragan nachar rizyklarga alyshtyrasyzmy? Sh@h@rg@ keregez, sez soragan n@rs@l@r anda bulyr". Alarga avyr eshl@r, khurlyk, meskenlek v@ Allahunyn' achuly kah@re iokl@telde. Alarga bu zh'@zalar Allahudan tieshle buldy Anyn' aiat'l@ren inkiar itk@nn@re h@m p@igamb@rl@rne khaksyz uterg@nn@re ochen, d@khi bu zh'@zalar alarga tieshle buldy Allahuga gonahly bulgannary h@m syzgan syzyktan chykkannary ochen.

Gam@lsez gen@ yshanuchylardan, v@ iahudl@rd@n, v@ nasaralardan h@m torle n@rs@l@rg@ tabynuchylardan ber@u Allahuga iman kiterep Kor'@n, sonn@t d@lill@re bel@n izge gam@ll@r kylsa, andyi moeminn@rnen' kylgan @zh'ere Rabbylary khozurynda, alarga kurku h@m kaigy bulmas.

Ian@ sezd@n g'@hed algan vakytybyzny kh@terl@gez! Ostegezg@ Tur tavyn kut@rdek v@ @ittek: "T@uratny alygyz h@m anyn' bel@n ikhlas v@ tyryshlyk il@ gam@l kylygyz, h@m anda bulgan Beznen' v@gaz'l@r bel@n v@gaz'l@negez, b@lki Allahdan kurkuchy bulyrsyz.

Tur tavynyn' ostegezg@ toshuenn@n Bez sezne kotkarganybyzdan son' kup vakyt utm@de, T@urat bel@n gam@l kylyrga birg@n v@g'd@gezne bozyp, anyn' bel@n gam@l kylmyi bashladygyz. @g@r sezg@ Allahunyn' faz'ly v@ r@khm@te bulmasa ide, @lb@tt@, h@mm@l@regez h@lak bulyr idegez.

Shimb@ kone khakynda Allah khokemen bozuchylarygyzny, @lb@tt@, beldegez. Chikt@n utuchel@rne h@lak itm@k ochen Allah alarga @itte: "Khur bulganygyz kh@ld@ - maimyl bulygyz", - dip. Shul vakytta Musanyn' kyz kard@she Firgaun iortyna kilde, ul @itte: "Bu sabyiny t@rbiial@p usteru ochen iakhshy khatynnan kh@b@r birimme?" - dip. Son'ra Musanyn' anasyn alyp kildel@r, Musa, @lb@tt@, uz anasyn kabul itte. Bez sine uz anan'a kaitardyk, sine kurep anan'nyn' kuzl@re kararlansyn v@ tynychlanyp kaigysy betsen ochen. @ittel@r: "Ii Rabbybyz, bez kurkabyz Firgaun ashygyp bezg@ g'@zab birer iaki iavyz eshne eshl@ven arttyryr" - dip.
Allah @itte: "Ii Musa, kurykmagyz, @lb@tt@, min seznen' bel@n, Firgaung@ soil@g@n suzl@regezne ishet@men h@m kur@men, sezne saklarmyn.

Barygyz ul Firgaung@ v@ @itegez: "Bez ikebez d@ sine khak ding@ ond@u ochen zh'ib@relg@n Rabbyn'nyn' p@igamb@rl@rebez. Iag'kub balalaryn beznen', bel@n zh'ib@r alarny torlech@ g'@zablama. Bez sin'a Rabbybyz tarafynnan kunderelg@n r@sull@r ik@nlegebezg@ mogzh'izalar bel@n kildek, Allahunyn' s@lame bez kurs@tk@n khak iulga kerg@n keshel@rg@der.
Doreslekt@ Allah g'@zaby p@igamb@rl@rne ialganga totyp, khaklyktan bash tartkan keshel@rg@, dip bezg@ Allahudan v@khii kilde.
Firgaun @itte: "Ii Musa! Seznen' Rabbygyz kem?"
Musa @itte: Beznen' Rabbybyz uze khalyk kylgan m@khluklaryna h@rn@rs@ne birde, son'ra uze birg@n n@rs@l@rd@n faidalanyrga keshel@rg@ iul kurs@tte, Islam dinen@ d@ iul kurs@tte.
Firgaun @itte: "@uv@ld@ ulep kitk@n keshel@rnen' kh@ll@re nichek, alar ikenche don'ia ochen gyibad@t kylalar ide".
Musa @itte: "Alarnyn' kh@ll@ren belm@k Allah khozuryndadyr, L@ukhul m@khfuzda iazylmysh. Minem Rabbym suzend@ v@ eshend@ hich khatalanmyi, h@m hich n@rs@ne onytmas.
Ul Allah zh'irne sezg@ tush@k kyldy, zh'ir ostend@ sezg@ iullar kyldy, v@ sezg@ kukt@n ian'gyr in'derde. Allah @itte: "Ian'gyr bel@n sezg@ zh'ird@n kup torle usemlekl@r chygardyk.
Bez chygargan rizyklardan iakhshylaryn ashagyz, v@ khaivannarga iaraklysyn alarga ashatygyz! Allahunyn' bu eshl@rend@ gakyl iial@ren@ gyibr@tl@r bar.
Bez sezne zh'ird@n iarattyk h@m uterep ian@ zh'irg@ kaitarabyz, v@ h@m kyiam@t bulganda ikenche m@rt@b@ sezne zh'ird@n chygarabyz.
T@khkyik Bez Firgaunga mogzh'izalarybyznyn' barchasyn kurs@ttek, Firgaun Musany ialganga khisaplady v@ an'a iman kiterud@n bash tartty.
Firgaun @itte: "Ii Musa, sikheren' bel@n bezne Mysyr zh'irenn@n chygaryrga kilden'me?

@lb@tt@, bez d@ sinen' sikheren' kebi sikher bel@n kilerbez, sikherl@rebezne kurs@tu ochen ber urynga kilerg@ beznen' bel@n sinen' aran'da v@g'd@ kyl, v@g'd@ itelg@n uryn h@m vakyt ike iakka da tigez bulyr, v@g'd@bezg@ bez d@, sez d@ khyilaflyk kylmyik".
Musa @itte: "Zh'yelachak kon seznen' b@ir@m konegez bulsyn, Mysyr khalky ul urynga toshk@ kh@tle zh'yelsynnar."
Firgaun kavemen@ kaitty v@ kh@il@l@ren kyldy h@m sikherchel@rd@n zh'yidy, son'ra sikherchel@re bel@n v@g'd@ itelg@n urynga kilde.
Musa @itte: "Sezg@ h@lak@tlek v@ g'@zab liazem, ialganny Allahuga iftira kylmagyz, Allah sezne uzenen' g'@zaby il@ h@lak it@r". Allahuga ialganny iftira ituche, shiksez, h@lak buldy.

Firgaunnyn' sikherchel@re Musanyn' suzl@ren ishetk@ch, uzara ikhtilaf kylyshtylar, kaiberl@re bu sikherche suze tugel didel@r, @g@r Musa zh'in's@, an'a iman kitererbez dig@n suzl@ren Firgavenn@n iasherdel@r.
Firgaunga iiarg@nn@re @ittel@r: "Oshbu ike ir sikherchel@r@der: alar sikherl@re bel@n sezne zh'iregezd@n chygaryrga h@m seznen' khak dinegezne artka kaldyryp uzl@renen' dinen osk@ chygaruny telil@r.
Firgaun @itte: "Musa bel@n Harunga karshy h@rber kh@il@ v@ sikherl@regezne zh'yegyz son'ra saf bulganygyz kh@ld@ kilegez. Bugen Musany zh'in'g@n keshe izge tel@gen@ iresher".
Sikherchel@r @ittel@r: "Ii Musa sin @uv@l tashlyisyn'my taiagyn'ny iaki @uv@l bez tashlyikmy?
Musa @itte: "B@lki sez @uv@l tashlagyz!" Sikherchel@r zh'epl@ren v@ taiaklaryn zh'irg@ salgach, elan bulyp iori bashladylar, bu elannar Musaga ioruche tere elannar bulyp khyial itelde,
Musa shul vakytta kun'elend@ kurku toidy.
@ittek: "Ii Musa, kurykma, sin alardan ostensen', alar zh'in'eler.

Taiagyn'ny zh'irg@ tashla, alarnyn' sikher bel@n elan itep kurs@tk@n zh'epl@ren v@ taiaklaryn ashasyn, alarnyn' iasagan elannary sikherchenen' kh@il@seder, sikherche kaida barsa da, kotylmas." Son'ra Musa taiagyn zh'irg@ tashlady h@m Musanyn' taiagy sikherchel@rnen' boten n@rs@l@ren ashap beterde.
Musanyn' taiagy sikherchel@rnen' boten n@rs@l@ren ashap beterg@ch, sikherchel@r, iman kiterdel@r, t@ub@ itep s@zh'd@g@ egyldylar h@m: "Harun bel@n Musanyn' Rabbysyna iman kiterdek", - didel@r.

Firgaun sikherchel@rg@ @itte: "Minem rokhs@temn@n bashka Harun v@ Musanyn' Rabbysyna iman kiterdegezme? Musa seznen' olug'larygyzdyr ki, sezg@ sikher belemen oir@tk@n, @lb@tt@, min seznen' un' kulygyzny v@ sul aiaklarygyzny kis@rmen v@ sezne khorm@ botaklaryna asarmyn, shul vakytta belersez minme iaki Mukhanyn' Rabbysymy katyrak g'@zab ituche v@ kaisybyznyn' g'@zaby daimi bulyr".

Iman kiterg@n sikherchel@r @ittel@r: "Ii Firgaun! Musanyn' p@igamb@rlegen@ kochle d@lil bulgan mogzh'izany h@m d@ bezne iaratuchy Allahny sin'a alyshtyrmyibyz, Allahuga da v@ Anyn' mogzh'izasyna d@ nyk yshandyk. Sin bezg@ khokem it, n@rs@ khokem it@ torgansyn'dyr, sin t@k@bberl@nep bu don'iada gyna khokem it@ alyrsyn', @mma akhir@tt@ khokem it@ almassyn'.

T@khkyik bez Rabbybyzga iman kiterdek, khatalarybyzny gafu itsen ochen d@khi Musaga karshy sinen' taraftan kochl@nep kylgan sikherebezne gafu itsen ochen, bit Allah s@vab birud@ kh@erle v@ g'@zab kyluda daimr@kder.
Ber@u kyiam@t konne Rabbysy khozuryna imansyz iaki kup gonah bel@n kils@, @lb@tt@, an'a zh'@h@nn@m bulyr, ul anda ulm@s h@m faidaly tereklek t@ bulmas.
Ber@u Rabbysyna izge gam@ll@r kylgany kh@ld@ kamil iman bel@n barsa, andyi moeminn@rg@ akhir@tt@ boek d@r@zh'@l@r bulyr.
Alarga G'@den isemle zh'@nn@tnen' agachlary astynnan elgalar agar, alar anda m@n'ge kalyrlar. Oshbu mokaf@t uzen koferd@n v@ bashka gonahlardan pak'lagan keshel@rg@der.

T@khkyik Musaga v@khii ittek, kollarym Iag'kub balalary bel@n Mysyr zh'irenn@n chygyp kitegez, alarny utk@ru ochen din'gezg@ taiagyn' bel@n sugyp kory iul iasa alarga. Firgaunnyn' artygyzdan zh'ituenn@n kurykma h@m d@ din'gez kushylyp batarbyz dip t@ kurkynma!"
Firgaun uzenen' gask@ren alyp, Musany totarga artlarynnan kua chykty, atly gask@re bel@n Musa artynnan kory iul bel@n din'gezg@ kerdel@r, din'gez kushylyp h@mm@se h@lak buldylar.
Firgaven uz kavemen azdyrdy, alarny tury iulga kunderm@de.

Ii Iag'kub balalary, t@khkyik Bez sezne doshmanygyz Firgavenn@n kotkardyk, v@ Tur tavy ianynda Musanyn' un' iagynnan sezg@ T@uratny v@g'd@ ittek, v@ sezg@ asharga kukt@n shirb@t h@m kosh iten in'derdek.

T@ub@ itep iman kiterg@n v@ Kor'@n iuly bel@n izge gam@ll@r kylgan, son'ra tury iulga kunelep ulg@nche khak iulda taza torgan keshel@rne Min, @lb@tt@, iarlykauchymyn.

Allah @itte: "Ii Musa, kavemen'ne kaldyryp ialgyz kilerg@ sine n@rs@ ashyktyrdy?" Chonki Musa Tur tavyna barganda uze bel@n keshe algan ide, tauga zh'itk@nd@ alarny arttarak kaldyryp uze aldanrak bardy.

Musa kaveme eshl@g@n esh ochen kaigyryp v@ achulanyp, kaveme ianyna kaitty. @itte: "Ii kavemem Rabbygyz sezg@ T@urat bir@m dip iakhshy v@g'd@ kyldy tugelme? Min sezg@ kyryk konn@n kaitam dip v@g'd@ birep kittem, @i@ sezg@ shul kyryk kon bik ozyn vakyt buldymy? Iaki Allahunyn' achuy v@ g'@zaby in'uen tel@degezme? Kaveme @itte: "Bez sinen' v@g'd@n'@ uz ikhtyiarybyz il@ khyilaflyk kylmadyk, l@kin Mysyrdan chykkan vakytybyzda Mysyr khatynnarynyn' biz@k @iberl@ren algan idek, ul biz@kl@rne h@mm@sen utka salyp erettek, Samiri d@ Zh'@brail atynyn' ezenn@n algan tufrakny utka saldy.

Allah @it@: "@i@ alar belmil@rme bu bozau, alarga hichn@rs@ soil@m@s, @g@r bozaunyn' uzen@ soil@s@l@r, zh'avap birm@s, v@ alarga faida kitererg@ d@, zarar kitererg@ d@ kadir bulmas."

Min'a iiarud@n sine n@rs@ tyidy? Iugyis@ minem @merem@ karyshtyn'my?"

Samiri @itte: "Iag'kub balalary kurm@g@n n@rs@ne min kurdem, Ul Zh'@brail f@resht@der, anyn' atynyn' aiagy ezenn@n ber uch tufrak aldym, ul tufrakny utka ereg@n biz@kl@r osten@ yrgyttym da bozau buldy, shulai eshl@rg@ n@fesem iakhshy kurde."

Musa Samirig@ @itte: "Bar, arabyzdan kit, l@kin hichkemg@ katnasha almassyn' h@m sin'a hichkem kil@ almas, don'iadagy g'@zabyn' osten@ akhir@tt@ d@ sin'a gazap v@g'd@ itelg@n ki, annan kotyla almassyn'. Ii Samiri, kara minem Ilah@m dig@n bozavyn'ny utta iandyrabyz, son'ra kolen kukk@ ochyrabyz! (Musa Samirine kom sakhr@sen@ kuyp zh'ib@r@, shunda z@khm@tl@nep iorep h@lak bula.)

B@lki borchagyznyn' da gyibad@t kylyrga tieshle bulgan Ilah@gez Allahu t@gal@der, An'ardan bashka hichber Ilah@ iuk, m@g@r Ul uze gen@. Anyn' beleme h@rn@rs@d@n kin' bulyp, vozh'udt@ bar n@rs@ne beleme echen@ syidyrdy.
Ii Mukh@mm@d g-m, @n@ shulai utk@nd@ge kavemn@rnen' kh@b@rl@ren sin'a ukyibyz. T@khkyik Bez sin'a uz khozurybyzdan Kor'@nne birdek, ul Kor'@nd@ h@rbersenen' kh@b@re bar.
Ber@u Kor'@nn@n bash tartsa, @lb@tt@, ul keshe kyiam@t konend@ katy g'@zabny kut@rer.
Alar anda m@n'ge kalyrlar, ul gazap alarga kyiam@t konne ni iaman iok bulyr.

Alar uzara soil@sherl@r, sez don'iada un kon gen@ tordygyz, dip.
Bez alarnyn' @itk@n suzl@ren bel@bez, b@lki alarnyn' gakylda kamiller@kl@re @iter: "Sez don'iada ber gen@ kon tordygyz", - dip.
Kyiam@t konend@ taular nichek bulyr, dip sinn@n soryilar. @it: "Ul kond@ taularny Rabbym urynnarynnan kubaryp kol kebi ochyryr.
Son'ra ul zh'irne tigez kylyr, ul@n usmi torgan itep.
Ul zh'ird@ chokyr h@m kalkulykny kurm@ssen'.

Ul kond@ keshel@r, m@khsh@r zh'iren@ chakyruchy Israfil f@resht@g@ iiarerl@r, ul chakyruchydan un'ga-sulga borylu bulmas, Allahudan kurkyp tavyshlar iomsharyr, h@m anda soil@shk@n tavyshny ishetm@ssen', m@g@r bik iomshak soil@sherl@r, kolakny soil@uchel@rnen' avyzyna ter@g@n kh@ld@ gen@ isheteler.
Ul kond@ hichkemnen' sh@f@gate faida birm@s, m@g@r Allah rokhs@t, birg@n kesheneke gen@ h@m don'iada vakytta khak suzl@rne soil@g@ne ochen Allah anyn' suzenn@n razyi bulgan kesheneke gen@ faida it@r.
Allah, keshel@rnen' allaryndagy eshl@ren d@ v@ artlaryndagy eshl@ren d@ bel@der, @mma keshel@r, Allahunyn' uzen d@ h@m eshen d@ belm@sl@r.
Ul kond@ keshel@rnen' iozl@re, h@rvakyt tere v@ h@rvakyt barcha vozh'ud ostenn@n kaim buluchy Allahuga khoshug' it@rl@r. T@khkyik h@lak buldy, Kor'@n bel@n gam@l itmich@ zolymny iokl@g@n keshe.
Ber@u moemin kh@lend@ izge gam@ll@rd@n kylsa, ul kesheg@ gonahyn arttyryp h@m s@vabyn kimetep zolym itu kurkynychy bulmas.

@n@ shulai h@rn@rs@ne b@ian ituche Kor'@nne gar@b telend@ in'derdek v@ ul Kor'@nd@ g'@zab bel@n kurkytuny kup kabatladyk keshel@r g'@zabtan kurkyp gonahtan saklansynnar ochen iaki @uv@lge kavemn@rnen' kh@ll@ren b@ian ituche kochle v@gaz' bulsyn ochen.

Allahu t@gal@ zatynda v@ syifatynda m@khluktan boek buldy, Ul h@rn@rs@g@ khaklyk bel@n khuzh'a buldy, Zh'@brail v@khiine ukyp t@mam itm@st@n elek, onytyrmyn dip ukyrga ashykma. Iag'ni f@resht@ ukyganda anyn' bel@n berg@ ukyma, b@lki tyn'lap tor. D@khi Rabbym belememne arttyr digen!
Minem gahedemne berenche bularak Ad@m g-m bozdy, bu agachtan ashama, dip, an'a @mer itmesh idek, l@kin ul Beznen' @merne onytty, Bez tyigan esht@n tyelyrga an'arga sabyrlyk ku@ten tapmadyk.
F@resht@l@rg@, khorm@t iozenn@n Ad@mg@ s@zh'd@ kylygyz dip @itk@n vakytybyzda f@resht@l@r h@mm@se s@zh'd@g@ kittel@r, m@g@r Iblis s@zh'd@ kylmady, Allah @merenn@n bash tartty.
@ittek: "Ii Ad@m, oshbu Iblis, @lb@tt@, sin'a v@ khatynyn'a doshman, saklan, sezne zh'@nn@tt@n chygarmasyn, @g@r zh'@nn@tt@n chyksan', kup avyrlyk chig@rsen'.
Doreslekt@ sin'a zh'@nn@tt@ achlyk v@ ialangachlyk iukdyr.

Shaitan Ad@mg@ v@sv@s@ kyldy v@ @itte: "Ii Ad@m, zh'@nn@tt@ m@n'ge kaluga v@ betmi torgan bailykka iia buluga s@b@ple zh'imeshne sezg@ kurs@timme" - dip kh@ram zh'imeshne asharga kyzyktyrdy.

H@m Ad@m h@m Kh@va kh@ram zh'imeshne ashadylar, d@rkh@l osl@renn@n kiemn@re toshep gaur@tl@re achyldy, bik ashygyp zh'@nn@tt@ge ber agach iafragy bel@n gaur@tl@ren kaplarga totyndylar, shulai itep Ad@m Rabbysyna gonahly buldy, doshmanynyn' ialgan suzen@ iiarep maksatyna ireshud@n kory kaldy.
Son'ra Rabbysy t@ub@ itterep uzen@ iakyn itte v@ t@ub@sen kabul itep gonahyn gafu itte h@m khaklykka kunderde.

Allah Ad@m il@ Iblisk@ @itte: "Ber-beregezg@ doshman bulganygyz kh@ld@ zh'@nn@tt@n chygygyz, @mma Minn@n sezg@, @lb@tt@, tury iulga kunderuche kitap kiler, Minem Hid@iatem@ iiarg@n keshe adashmas h@m bozylyp iavyzlardan bulmas.

V@ ber@u Minem kitabym bel@n gam@l kyludan v@ Min kurs@tk@n tury iuldan barudan bash tartsa, an'a hid@iatsez v@ b@khetsez tar tormysh bulyr, kyiam@t konend@ Bez ul keshene kuze h@m kun'ele sukyr kh@ld@ kubaryrbyz.
Sukyr kh@lend@ kubarylgach @itte: "I@ Rabbi mine ni ochen sukyr kh@lemd@ kubardyn', bit min don'iada vakytymda kuzle idem?"

Allah @iter: "@ie, esh sin @itk@nch@der, don'iada vakytygyzda Bez sezg@ kuz, kolak, tel h@m gakyl birg@n idek h@m h@rn@rs@ne b@ian ituche kitap in'derg@n idek, l@kin sez Beznen' aiat'l@rebezne onyttygyz hich kir@ksenm@degez, Beznen' aiat'l@rebezne onytkanyn' kebi, bugen zh'@h@nn@md@ kalyp onytylyrsyn'.
N@fesen@ iiarep chikt@n utep kitk@n h@m Rabbysynyn' aiat'l@ren@ yshanmagan keshel@rg@ d@ shundyi zh'@za bir@ch@kbez, akhir@t g'@zaby, @lb@tt@, don'ianykynnan katyrak h@m m@n'ge kaluchyrak.

@it: "@g@r Allahuga ialvaruygyz h@m gyibad@tegez bulmasa, Allah seznen' bel@n n@rs@ eshl@r ide, iag'ni Allahuga gyibad@t kylmasagyz h@m itagat' itm@s@gez, An'a ni ochen kir@ksez? Ii kire t@k@bber keshel@r, t@khkyik Kor'@nne v@ r@sulne ialganga tottygyz, bu eshegez ochen sezg@ g'@zab liazem buldy!

@i@ alar zh'irg@ karamyilarmy, irle v@ khatynly itep kupme iakhshy n@rs@l@r usterdek.
@lb@tt@ bu esht@ Allahunyn' kodr@ten@ iman kiteru ochen achyk gal@m@tl@r bar, l@kin alarnyn' kuber@ge yshanuchy tugell@r.
@lb@tt@ sinen' Rabbyn' ostenlek v@ ku@t iiase, imansyzlarga katy zh'@za birer, moeminn@r ochen r@khimleder.

H@m bilgel@ng@n vakytka sikherchel@r zh'yeldylar.

Firgaun @itte: "@lb@tt@ bulyr, @g@r Musany zh'in's@gez minem iakynnarymnan bulyrsyz".

@ittel@r: "Synymnarga gyibad@t kylabyz, h@rvakyt alarga gyibad@tt@ bulabyz", - dip.

@ittel@r: "Iuk, synymnarybyz ishetmi d@, faida v@ zarar it@rg@ d@ kochl@re zh'itmi, b@lki atalarybyz da shulai beznen' kebi kyilalar ide, bez d@ alarga iiarep shulai kyilabyz", - dip.
Ibrahim @itte: "@i@ kur@sezme gyibad@t kyilgan synymnarygyzny.

@g@r avyrsam Ul min'a s@lam@tlek bir@.

Oshbu Allahuga karyshyp h@lak bulgan Nukh kavemenen' h@lak buluynda gakylly keshel@r ochen, @lb@tt@, gyibr@tl@r bar, ul kavemnen' kubr@ge, iag'ni h@lak bulgannary berse d@ yshanuchy tugel ide.

@it: "@lb@tt@, mine Allah khokemenn@n hichkem kotkara almas, @g@r Ul min'a zarar tel@s@, min, @lb@tt@, tapmamyn Allahudan bashka sygynyr v@ iard@m sorar ochen ber zatny."

M@g@r min sezg@ Allah khokemn@ren ireshteruche h@m p@igamb@rlek burychyn ut@uche gen@men. Ber@u Allahuga v@ Anyn' rasulen@ gasyi bulsa alarga karshy torsa, t@khkyik ul kesheg@ zh'@h@nn@m uty kh@zerl@nmeshter alar anda m@n'ge kaluchylardyr.
Kh@tta alar uzl@ren@ v@g'd@ itelg@n g'@zabny kurs@l@r, tiz belerl@r kemnen' iard@mchese z@gyif'r@k v@ azyrak ik@nlegen.
@it: "Belmimen sezg@ v@g'd@ itelg@n kyiam@t kone iakyndyrmy, @ll@ Rabbym ul kyiam@t konen@ ozyn vakyt bilgel@g@nme?
Ul iasheren eshl@rne belucheder v@ Ul uzenen' iasheren eshl@ren@ hichkemne kh@b@rdar kylmas.
M@g@r r@sull@rnen' allarynnan v@ artlarynnan sakchy f@resht@l@ren iorter Iblis zarar birm@sen ochen.

Ul r@sull@r Rabbylary iokl@g@n p@igamb@rlek burychlaryn ut@g@nlekl@ren v@ sh@rigat' khokemn@ren keshel@rg@ ireshterg@nn@ren belsen ochen alar ianyna f@resht@l@r bilgel@de, v@ rasul tir@send@ bulgan h@r keshenen' eshen Allahunyn' beleme @il@nderep aldy, v@ Ul - Allah vozh'udt@ bulgan h@rn@rs@nen' sanyn bel@der.
Ii kieme il@ bork@ng@n p@igamb@r.
Gyibad@t ochen tonl@ uiau tor, m@g@r tonnen' berazyn iokla, ial it.
Iaki tonnen' iartysynnan beraz azyragyn da gyibad@t ochen tor, iaki iarty tonne gyibad@t ochen uiau tor.
Iaki iarty tonn@n kubr@k tor, v@ Kor'@nne t@rtibe bel@n tyn'lap torgan keshe suzl@rne dores an'larlyk itep ashykmyicha ukygyz!
Bez, @lb@tt@, avyr suzne sin'a tiz iokl@rbez, iag'ni n@fes soim@g@n sh@rigat' khokemn@ren.
Topl@ toryp namaz, Kor'@n uku, @lb@tt@, n@fesk@ katyrak m@sh@kat'ter v@ ukylyshta suzl@re doreser@k h@m kun'elg@ t@esirler@kter.
@lb@tt@, kondez sinen' eshl@ren' kupter, esht@n bushangach tynychlanyp kichl@ren Allahuga gyibad@t kyl!
Rabbyn'nyn' isemen zeker it, An'a gyibad@t kyl h@m gyibad@tt@ don'ia uilarynnan kisel, nyklap kiselep kun'elen'ne f@kat' Allahuga bag'la!
Ul - Allah m@shrik'nyn' v@ m@g'ribnen' Rabbysy, hich m@g'bud iuk, m@g@r Allah uze gen@der, Any barcha eshl@ren'd@ uzen'@ khuzh'a itep al!
V@ alarnyn' khakka karshy soil@g@n m@g'n@sez suzl@ren@ chyda, v@ alarny ber tarafka kui kurk@m kuiu bel@n!
Mine v@ Minem bel@n berg@ kui, Kor'@nne ialgan diiuche bailarny v@ olug'larny, Min alarny Uzem khokem it@rmen, v@ alarga beraz vakyt bir!
T@khkyik Beznen' kulybyzda zh'@h@nn@m h@m avyr bogaular bardyr.
D@khi tamakka utyra torgan iaman ashamlyklar h@m r@nzh'etkuche g'@zab bardyr.

T@khkyik Bez sezg@ rasul zh'ib@rdek khakny kabul ituegezg@ iaki kabul itm@vegezg@ guah kylyp, Firgaunga rasul zh'ib@rg@nebez kebi.
Firgaun r@sulg@ karyshty doshman buldy, Bez any katy totyp h@lak ittek.
Ii keshel@r, akhir@t g'@zabynnan nichek kotylyrsyz, kyiam@t konenen' katylygy gonahsyz sabyi balalarnyn' ch@chl@ren agartyr?

T@khkyik bu Kor'@n h@mm@ n@rs@d@n kh@b@r biruche, zh'@nn@t iulyn kurs@tep zh'@nn@tk@ chakyruchy h@m zh'@h@nn@m iulyn kurs@tep annan tyiuchydyr, sezd@n tel@g@n keshe Kor'@n bel@k v@gaz'l@nep h@m gam@l kylyp Rabbysynyn' tury iulyna kerer.

T@khkyik sinen' Rabbyn' bel@der, @lb@tt@, sin tonnen' ocht@n ike oleshenn@n az gyna kimr@k toryp gyibad@t kylasyn', kaivakytta tonnen' iartysyny torasyn', v@ kaivakyt ocht@n beren torasyn', d@khi sinen' bel@n berg@ toryp ber taif@ moeminn@r gyibad@t kylyrlar. Allah tonne h@m konne belep ulchider, Allah bel@der, @lb@tt@, sez ul tonnen' barcha s@gat'l@ren d@ rigaia kylyp beter@ almassyz, sezg@ zh'in'el@itte ul tonne. Tonl@ ukyla torgan namazlarda kyira@tne uzegezg@ bik avyr kilm@slek itep zh'in'elr@k sur@l@rne ukygyz! Allah belde, seznen' aragyzda avyru keshel@r bulyr, v@ kaiberl@re Allahunyn' iumartlygynnan omet itep mal, gyilem k@seb it@r ochen s@f@rd@ bulyrlar, v@ kaiberl@re Allah iulynda sugyshta bulyrlar, andyi vakytlarda zh'in'el sur@l@rne ukygyz, v@ namazlarygyzny ukygyz, v@ mallarygyzdan z@kiat biregez h@m izge gam@ll@rne Allahuga burych itep biregez iag'ni s@vably eshl@rne f@kat' Allah rizalygy ochen eshl@gez, Allah arttyryp uzegezg@ nig'm@t bel@n kaitaryp birer. Uzegez ochen akhir@tk@ aldan zh'ib@rg@n iakhshylyklarygyzny, izge gam@ll@regezne Allah khozurynda tabarsyz, uzegez ulg@nn@n son' vasyiategez buencha birelg@n sadakagyzga karaganda is@n vakytygyzda birg@n sadakagyz kh@erler@k v@ s@vaby da olugrak. Allahunyn' iarlykavyn h@rvakyt soragyz! Shiksez, Allah gonahlarny iarlykauchy v@ r@khimle.
Ii tyshky kieme il@ bork@ng@n p@igamb@r!

Torgyl, keshel@rne Allah g'@zaby bel@n kurkyt! Mukh@mm@d g-m zh'ir bel@n kuk arasynda t@khetk@ utyrgan Zh'@brail f@resht@ne kurep kurykty, tiz gen@ oen@ kaityp iatty h@m Kh@dizh'@g@ tyshky kiemn@re bel@n kaplarga kushty. Rabbyn'ny zurlap t@kbir @it.
V@ kiemen'ne n@zh'@s@tt@n pak' kyl.

Kesheg@ bern@rs@ birs@n' annan kubr@kne omet itep birm@.

@g@r kyiam@t ochen sur orels@.

K@ferl@rg@ zh'in'ellege iuk avyr konder.
Min khalyk kylgan ber keshe bel@n Mine ialgyzymny gyna kui.

V@ uze ianynda gyna tora torgan balalar birdek, iag'ni atalary bai bulgach, balalary s@ud@ bel@n kitep iorm@del@r.

Iuk inde, Bezd@n iakhshylyk kotm@sen, t@khkyik ul Beznen' aiat'l@rebezg@ karysha ide.

Any bik m@sh@kat'le bulgan g'@zabka kertermen. Ul V@lid isemle ber bai moshrikter, M@kk@ moshrikl@re an'a kin'@shk@ kildel@r h@m Kor'@n v@ Mukh@mm@d khakynda anyn' fikeren soradylar. V@lid @itte: "Sez Mukh@mm@dne divana disez, bu suzegez hich dores tugel, anyn' gakylly ik@nlege tir@-iakka m@g'lumder. Sez any sikherche disez, anyn' sikher bel@n shogyl'l@ng@ne hich zahir bulgany iuk. Sez any ialganchy disez, anyn' ialgan soil@g@nen bu kong@ch@ hichkem ishetk@ne iuk, h@m anyn' suzl@re shagyir' suzen@ d@ okhshamyi", - dip. Moshrikl@r: sin nindi kin'@sh bir@sen', an'a ni dip @itik, didel@r. V@lid alarnyn' soraularyna zh'avap bire almyicha uiga kaldy.
T@khkyik ul - V@lid Kor'@n h@m p@igamb@r khakynda nichek m@kerlek kylyrga dip fikerl@de, uzench@ khalyklarga soil@rg@ ialgan suzl@r d@ kh@zerl@de.

Ul sakarda untugyz g'@zab f@resht@l@re bardyr. "Moshrikl@r bu suzne ishetk@ch: "G'@zab f@resht@l@re untugyz gyna bulgach bez alarga karshy tora alyrbyz, alar bezne g'@zab kyla almaslar", - didel@r.

Ut iial@ren, iag'ni zh'@h@nn@mg@ g'@zab kyluchylarny bashka zattan kylmadyk f@kat' f@resht@l@rd@n kyldyk, v@ alarnyn' sannaryn untugyz dip @ittek, f@kat' k@ferl@rg@ fetn@ bulsyn ochen, v@ Inzh'il, T@urat @hell@re Mukh@mm@d g-mnen' khak p@igamb@r ik@nlegen@ yshansynnar ochen. (Chonki T@uratta, Inzh'ild@ d@ untugyz dip zeker itelmeshter). Rabbyn'nyn' gask@rl@ren Allahudan bashka hichkem belm@s, ul sakara zh'@h@nn@me h@m untugyz f@resht@ bushka soil@nm@de, m@g@r keshel@rg@ v@gaz' ochen soil@nde.

Iuk @le, alar tieshsezne soramasynnar, b@lki alar akhir@t g'@zabynnan kurykmyilar. @g@r kuryksalar ide, @lb@tt@, iman kiterep Kor'@n bel@n gam@l kylyr idel@r h@m Kor'@nn@n bashka d@lil soramas idel@r.

@lb@tt@, kyiam@t kone bel@n ant it@men.
H@m ukenep uzen shelt@ kyluchy keshe bel@n ant it@men. (Kyiam@tt@ h@r keshe uzen shelt@ kylyr: iakhshy bulsa iakhshylykny nik kubr@k kylmadym dip, Iaman bulsa iamanlykny nik kyldym, diiar).
@i@ Ad@m balasy uilyimy - ulg@ch anyn' chereg@n soiakl@ren Bez zh'yia almabyz dip? (Kup keshe: "Soiage cherep betk@n ad@m nichek terelsen", - dil@r).
@i@ koche zh'ituchel@rd@nbez keshenen' chereg@n kechken@ barmak soiakl@ren ber-bersen@ kusharga.
B@lki ad@m balasy Allah iokl@g@nne kuep kil@ch@k gomeren'd@ n@fese tel@g@n bozyk eshl@rne kylyp iorerg@ telider
Ul keshe: kyiam@t kaichan bula @le, dip soryidyr
H@rkaichan kyiam@tnen' kurkynychynnan kuzl@r tonyp karan'gylansa.

G@rch@ faryz gam@ll@rne kaldyryp kh@ram eshl@rne eshl@g@n ochen gozerl@r kurs@ts@ d@. (Iag'ni uze gozerl@r kurs@tep soil@s@ d@ barcha @g'zalary anyn' zararyna guahlyk birerl@r).
Ul Kor'@n aiat'l@ren t@k'rar @itu bel@n telen'ne tibr@tm@, Zh'@brail g-m sin'a ukygan aiat'l@rne ashygyp ianyn'a alyr ochen.

Iuk, alai kir@km@s, don'iany ashygyp k@sep it@sez h@m bik soiasez.
@mma akhir@tne artka kuiasyz anyn' ochen ashykmyisyz.
Kyiam@t konend@ kaiber iozl@r shatlanyp agaruchydyr.

D@khi kaiber iozl@r kaigydan sytyk v@ kara bulyr.
Anyn' kh@len kurg@ch arka buynnaryn syndyruchy g'@zab kilg@n, dip uilarsyn'.
Iuk @le, an' bulygyz @g@r zh'an kukr@knen' iugary iagyna zh'its@,
shul vakytta mon'a kh@zer kem daru, iard@m birer dip @itels@, iaki f@resht@l@r, bu keshenen' zh'anyn r@khm@t f@resht@l@re alyrmy @ll@ g'@zab f@resht@l@re alyrmy dis@l@r.
Inde bu keshe don'iadan aerylam, dip uilar.
Don'iadan kit@ torgan bu kesheg@ katylyk osten@ katylyk ost@ler, iag'ni don'iadan v@ iakynnarynnan aerylu, Allahudan kurku h@m zh'an biru avyrlygy.
Bugen barmak Rabbyn' khozuryndadyr.
Imansyz, dinsez keshe Rabbysy khozuryna bargach, m@n'geg@ aldanganyn beler, ul yshanyrga tieshle n@rs@l@rg@ yshanmady h@m namaz da ukymady.
L@kin Kor'@nne ialganga totty h@m kabul itud@n bash tartty.

Ii mondyi keshe sin'a g'@zab tiesh, g'@zab tiesh!
D@khi sin'a g'@zab tiesh, g'@zab tiesh!
@n@ ad@m balasy uzen@ Allahudan iokl@m@ iokl@telm@une, Allahuga karshy eshl@rd@ ikhtyiarga kuelumy h@m akhyrda zh'avapsyzlykny telime?

Bu eshl@rne eshl@g@n Allahunyn' ulekl@rne tergezerg@ koche zh'itm@sme?

@i@ kesheg@ zamanynda ber vakyt kilep utte tugelme, ul vakytta keshe telg@ alyna torgan n@rs@ tugel ide. Ad@m g-m balchyktan khalyk itelg@ch, M@kk@ il@ Taif arasynda bernikad@r vakytlar iatty, hich teld@ soil@nm@de.
T@khkyik Bez Adom balalaryn iarattyk, ir il@ khatynnyn' katnashkan m@nil@renn@n, Bez any b@lal@nderep synarbyz, any ishetuche v@ kuruche kyldyk.
T@khkyik an'a tury iulnyn' sibeshl@ren kurs@ttek, ul keshe Bez birg@n nig'm@tl@rg@ i@ shoker itucheder, i@ nig'm@tl@rne Allah birg@nlegen inkiar itucheder.
T@khkyik Bez nig'm@tl@rg@ koferlek kyluchylarga kh@zerl@dek chylbyrlarny v@ bogaularny h@m kyzgan utny.
T@khkyik iakhshy moselmannar t@mle sular ech@rl@r, ul sunyn' ise h@m t@me k@fur (kamfora) kebider.
Ul k@fur chishm@der, annan ech@rl@r Allahunyn' itagat'le kollary, v@ ul chishm@ne nichek kir@k - shulai agyzyrlar.

Alar don'iada vakytta Allahudan iokl@telg@n burychlaryn ut@rl@r, iag'ni Allah kushkan eshl@rne eshl@rl@r v@ Ul tyigan eshl@rd@n tyelyrlar, v@ alar katylygy h@rkaida taralgan kyiam@t konenn@n kurkyrlar.
D@khi alar Allah rizasy ochen meskenn@rg@, iatimn@rg@ h@m totkynda bulgan moselmannarga ash h@m sadaka birerl@r.
Alar @iterl@r: "Bez sezne f@kat' Allah rizasy ochen gen@ ashatabyz, bez sezd@n omet itmibez karshysyna bezg@ ber izgelek ituegezne h@m doga kylygyz, dip t@ @itmibez.
Chonki bez Rabbybyzdan kurkabyz katylygy bel@n iozl@rne chytyklandyruchy kyiam@t konenn@n", - dip.
Allah alarny ul konnen' katylygynnan saklar h@m alarnyn' iozl@rem@ iaktylykny d@khi shatlykny salyr.
D@khi alarmy Allah iulynda chydamly bulgannary ochen zh'@nn@t h@m ef@k kiemn@r bel@n bul@kl@r.
